bio: Guy Korland, PhD in Computer Science from TAU (Tel Aviv University), is the CEO and Co-founder of FalkorDB, where he builds a powerful Graph Database to power Generative AI applications. With a career spanning more than 20 years of experience in the database and software engineering industry, including a previous role as SVP, CTO of Incubation at Redis, Guy’s well-rounded profile brings a balance of R&D, business, and user experience to tech conferences. He aims to make the crowd think beyond the fluff by discussing the good, the bad, and the ugly of the industry.

Liat Iusim is a Solutions Architect at AWS, specializing in streaming and real-time analytics. With a background as a Tech Lead and Data Engineer, Liat brings hands-on experience in designing and building highly scalable, distributed data systems. She is passionate about helping organizations harness the power of real-time data, leveraging technologies such as Apache Kafka, Apache Flink, and OpenSearch to solve complex data challenges at scale.

tagline: Sr. Principal MLOps Architect, Palo Alto Networks
bio:
I am a Sr. Principal MLOps Architect at Palo Alto Networks, with over 20 years of experience across technology, cybersecurity, cloud, and DevOps.
 
 For more than 10 years, I have focused on designing scalable, reliable, and secure cloud platforms, DevOps and MLOps solutions, and automated pipelines, with a strong focus on AWS, Python, and modern software engineering practices.

Tamir Shazman is a Data Scientist at Fetcherr building Large Market Models using deep learning to simulate market behavior. With a Master's in Data and Decision Sciences from the Technion, he specializes in reinforcement learning and applying advanced mathematics to real-world business challenges.

At S.P. Data, I lead cloud data initiatives and work as a solution architect, helping customers move from traditional on-prem environments to modern cloud platforms. A big part of that is making sure the data is not only migrated, but organized and prepared in a way that can support AI use cases later on. I’m also focused on automation around data integration and data warehouses, so less of the work depends on manual development and maintenance. That includes building repeatable pipelines, automating data movement and transformations, and making the warehouse easier to operate as the environment grows. For me, the AI part starts with getting the cloud and data foundation right first.

Raz Tamir is a Senior Data Scientist at monday.com, with previous experience leading data science and AI teams. His work spans the full data science lifecycle: translating business goals into ML, AI, and agentic systems, from research and modeling to deployment, monitoring, and product impact. Raz has built production AI systems across multiple domains, including deep learning for computer vision, time series, agentic workflows, and applied ML. He is passionate about helping teams build AI products with clear evaluation, practical feedback loops, and production-grade discipline

I lead R&D and Product at Plurai, where we build infrastructure for agent simulation, evaluation and optimization. Before that I was CTO at Rupert, building predictive signals and agentic workflows, and led engineering and product at Nexar, where we built a digital twin of the world powered by computer vision. Throughout, I've lived in the overlap between AI, engineering, and product — the one translating between what's technically possible, what's buildable, and what people actually need. What drives me is simplifying the complex: taming hard technical problems on one side, and making things genuinely clear for people on the other.

bio:

Tal Avraham is an Industrial and Management Engineer (B.Sc., Ben-Gurion University) with over six years of experience in data analytics. She enjoys bridging the gap between product, engineering, and analytics to build reliable data solutions for fast-moving teams. Her experience working in a startup environment inspired the idea behind this talk.

Her work spans algorithms R&D, data and analytics engineering, AI engineering, and security research. She holds a B.Sc. in Computer Science from the Open University of Israel.

Noa holds an M.Sc. in Data Science and Engineering from Ben-Gurion University. In her free time, Noa enjoys hiking and relaxing at the beach.

 She holds a B.Sc. in Computer Science from the Technion and an M.Sc. in Computer Science from the Weizmann Institute of Science.

tagline: Director of EMEA Solution Architecture, Aerospike
bio:
Guy Carmin is a hiker, biker, metalhead, and Director of EMEA Solution Architecture at Aerospike, where he leads solution architecture and technical advisory activities across the EMEA region.
 
 
 
 Guy brings nearly 30 years of experience in the technology industry, spanning cloud, open source, big data, and NoSQL databases. In his role, he helps organizations design and implement business-critical data systems that operate in real time, at massive scale, and with uncompromising performance.
 
 
 
 He works closely with customers and partners throughout both the technical and business journey — from defining requirements and shaping architecture, through workshops and proofs of concept, to implementation and system expansion. He also leads technical pre-sales initiatives, develops competitive strategies, and supports the development of Solution Architecture teams across the region.
 
 
 
 At the heart of his work is the ability to connect complex business challenges with clear, practical, and scalable technology solutions. What drives him is turning complex technology into solutions that work in the real world, while sharing knowledge that helps people and organizations make better decisions.
 
 
 
 Guy believes in combining deep technical expertise, critical thinking, collaboration, and a genuine appreciation for people, while building long-term relationships based on trust, curiosity, and results.

AI leader, social entrepreneur, lecturer and space enthusiast. I am CTO at the National AI Directorate and I am interested in any do-good AI. I also love public speaking and teaching AI. I completed a Master's degree in Computer Science at Bar-Ilan University with an NLP thesis and a Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering at the Technion.

During the day he's the proud father of 5 little devils and at night he secretly translates French comics into Hebrew.

Solutions Architect at ClickHouse with 15+ years of experience across AWS, Big Data, Analytics, SaaS, and AI.

 Public speaker with experience in talks at Meetups, AWS summit, DataTLV and other.

 He has led data science projects in classification, claims, and claim loss-ratio prediction, and developed predictive models that helped improve insurance risk assessment.
 
 These days, Gil is all-in on LLM agents and agentic workflows, exploring what happens when a data scientist trades writing code for orchestrating a fleet of AI agents that can research, experiment, and evaluate on their own.
 
 In his free time, Gil enjoys hiking, working out, and listening to audiobooks.

His data journey began in the Israel Defense Forces’ elite Unit 8200, then advanced through roles as a Senior Quantitative Researcher at WorldQuant and a founding data scientist at Loops. Itay holds a B.Sc. in Physics and Computer Science (with distinction) from Tel Aviv University and is passionate about translating cutting-edge research into business impact.
 
 
 
 When he steps away from the keyboard, Itay enjoys bird-watching, practicing yoga, and watching classic world cinema.

She specializes in predictive Lifetime Value (pLTV) optimization, Bayesian Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM), and advanced causal methodologies. Jasmine holds a PhD in Neuroscience from Tel Aviv University and is passionate about translating advanced statistical architectures into high-impact business outcomes.

bio:
Maya Malamud is a Healthcare AI Consultant and the Founder of Malamud AI Advisory, specializing in trustworthy AI, clinical NLP, and cascading pipeline architecture for HealthTech startups. 
 
 
 
 With over a decade in machine learning and data science, she spends her days making sure AI systems are production-ready, auditable, and reliable before they reach patients - and her research asks what happens when the training data itself is the problem.

I spend most of my time tackling the unglamorous but critical challenge of making data pipelines trustworthy, scalable, and resilient in production environments.

Her full stack infrastructure includes a Snowflake warehouse, multiple AWS Lambda ETL streams, an internal analytics portal behind Okta SSO, and Elsa, a production-grade AI data assistant serving the entire organization. An analyst by training rather than a software engineer, Stav champions the strategic shift from writing repetitive queries to designing organizational semantics and managing autonomous agentic ecosystems.

 Throughout her career, Oshrat has held senior leadership positions, including Senior Director, Digital Natives Israel and VP of Sales, where she worked closely with enterprise organizations, technology companies, and startups to bridge business needs with innovative technology solutions.
 
 
 
 She began her career in the Israel Defense Forces' C4I Corps, building a solid technical foundation before moving into product management, business development, and technology sales leadership. Her combination of deep technical understanding and commercial expertise enables her to help organizations design innovative solutions while building long-term partnerships based on trust and measurable business outcomes.

Software engineer with background in HPC, algorithms, and backend development. My day-to-day involves lowering costs for pipelines and conveying those improvements to customers. Currently handling data engineering at EON with an emphasis on optimization.

 Dina is an AWSuperstar, international speaker, lecturer, mentor, and technical writer. She is passionate about making complex AI concepts practical, understandable, and actually usable by engineering teams.

Programming since I was 16.

 Community organizer at DykesWhoTech IL, an LGBT women's community.
